title: Tents Remastered
description: Tents Remastered is a Mod that adds Tents to the game for Neoforge
body:
**Tents Remastered** is the ultimate camping mod! Explore your world to find naturally spawning tents or craft your own portable Tent placer to set up camp anywhere instantly. This mod also introduces **White wool stairs**(Only variant) for your builds. Tents naturally spawn in Deserts, Snowy Plains, and Plains. **Tents Remastered** is meant to give players the new Abandoned Camp from Minecraft Live May 2026.
## Features
### Items:
- White Wool Stairs
- Tent Placer
### Structures:
- Tent
